call_points.text: No FY27 revenue or margin guidance; management expects Q3 and Q4 peak season to offset the Q1 Maldives fuel hit.
CRISIL AA/Stable retained for Ventive; key subsidiaries at CRISIL AA+/Stable.
Sahyadri Hills Ritz-Carlton Reserve acquired 100% for about ₹281 Cr equity and ₹466 Cr enterprise value, targeting yield on cost above 12%.
Sri Lanka Ritz-Carlton Reserve delayed: an analyst noted the earlier FY28-end timeline now reads around FY31; management targets around FY30 pending permissions.
Management declined to give a Maldives EBITDA margin for FY27, saying it depends on the war situation.
Whitefield AC by Marriott conversion to be completed by March 2027; Varanasi and Ritz-Carlton Reserve in FY28.
Mundra opportunity put on hold pending reassessment of return profile and timing.
Average cost of rupee debt fell to about 7.3% from 9.5% and USD debt to 6.2% from 8.3%, saving about ₹20 Cr.
Ratings held at CRISIL AA Stable for Ventive and AA+ for the material subsidiary.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: As per the assessment order passed by the faceless unit of the Income Tax Department, there is no change in income assessed as compared to income reported in income tax return filed for FY 2023-24 (AY 2024-25). However, the computation of income forming part of the Assessment Order for AY 2024-25 (FY 2023-24) contains errors, which have consequently resulted in an erroneous tax demand of Rs. 6,37,96,318/- (Rupees Six Crores Thirty Seven Lakhs Ninety Six Thousand Three Hundred and Eighteen Only) raised on the Company, inclusive of interest.
tax_litigation.opposing_party: Deputy Commissioner of Income Tax, Circle 1, Pune
tax_litigation.status: The said Rectification Application has been accepted by the Assessing Officer. Accordingly, the error in computation forming part of the assessment order has been rectified and there is no change in the income assessed. Consequently, the demand of Rs. 6,37,96,318/- (Rupees Six Crores Thirty-Seven Lakhs Ninety-Six Thousand Three Hundred and Eighteen Only) raised earlier on account of such error stands addressed and the same has been reduced to NIL. The order dated 23rd April 2026 was received on 27th April 2026.
